about: A Berry the player's Pokemon handed to a wild Pokemon, and Incinerate then burnt, is gone as one the wild Pokemon eats: it does not go to the bag at the battle's end. Pokemon Central's Raggiro (ninth generation) sends to the bag what was handed to a wild Pokemon, the Berries it consumes excepted, and its Bruciatutto has the Berry destroyed, out of Recycle's and Harvest's reach, and says nothing of the bag; the player's own Berry burnt is not given back either (incinerate_burns_the_party_s_berry.json). A level-10 Chansey holding an Oran Berry (savedit --party's item), whose low Sp. Atk leaves its foe standing, is taught Trick and Incinerate (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Splash and holds an Oval Stone (set:): the Trick swaps the two items, Incinerate burns the Oran Berry, gym.py's player wins the battle, and the party's Chansey holds the Oval Stone while the bag has no Oran Berry. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
